title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 131
paragraphs: He spent many days in the region of Pieria, for meanwhile a third of his army was cutting the road over the Macedonian mountains, so that the whole host could pass by this way into the land of the Perrhaebians. Now too the heralds returned who had been sent to Greece to demand earth, some empty-handed, others bearing earth and water.
